faqs.question: Are gifts expected?
faqs.answer: No boxed gifts! Your presence and good energy are all that's wanted.

faqs.answer: Yes! The pool and spa will be heated throughout the evening.

closing.message: Bring your swimwear and good energy. See you at sunset!
